title: "Homework 1: R Code"
output: html_document

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tibble)
library(scales)

file_a <- "A07594__Circle_of_Commerce.txt"
file_b <- "B14801__Free_Trade.txt"


text_a <- read_file(file_a)
text_b <- read_file(file_b)


texts <- tibble(
  doc_title = c("Text A", "Text B"),
  text = c(text_a, text_b)
)


words <- texts %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text)

words

before_counts <- words %>%
  count(doc_title, name = "total_tokens")


before_counts

data("stop_words")


custom_stopwords <- tibble(
  word = c(
    "vnto", "haue", "doo", "hath", "bee", "ye", "thee"
  )
)


all_stopwords <- bind_rows(stop_words, custom_stopwords) %>%
  distinct(word)


words_clean <- words %>%
  anti_join(all_stopwords, by = "word")


after_counts <- words_clean %>%
  count(doc_title, name = "tokens_after_stopwords")


corpus_diagnostics <- before_counts %>%
  left_join(after_counts, by = "doc_title") %>%
  mutate(
    tokens_removed = total_tokens - tokens_after_stopwords,
    percent_removed = tokens_removed / total_tokens * 100
  )


print(corpus_diagnostics, width = Inf)

# 第二部分
word_counts_before <- words %>%
  count(doc_title, word, sort = TRUE)


word_counts_after <- words_clean %>%
  count(doc_title, word, sort = TRUE)


word_counts_before
word_counts_after

plot_data_before <- word_counts_before %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = doc_title,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(max_n = pmax(`Text A`, `Text B`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Text A`, `Text B`),
    names_to = "doc_title",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, n, .fun = max))


plot_before <- ggplot(plot_data_before, aes(x = n, y = word)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ doc_title, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Before stopword removal",
    subtitle = "Top 15 words ranked by maximum count across both texts",
    x = "Word frequency (count)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)


print(plot_before)


ggsave(
  "hw1_words_before.png",
  plot = plot_before,
  width = 10, height = 6, units = "in",
  dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

plot_data_after <- word_counts_after %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = doc_title,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(max_n = pmax(`Text A`, `Text B`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Text A`, `Text B`),
    names_to = "doc_title",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, n, .fun = max))


plot_after <- ggplot(plot_data_after, aes(x = n, y = word)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ doc_title, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "After stopword removal",
    subtitle = "Top 15 words ranked by maximum count across both texts",
    x = "Word frequency (count)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)


print(plot_after)


ggsave(
  "hw1_words_after.png",
  plot = plot_after,
  width = 10, height = 6, units = "in",
  dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# 第三部分：测试自定义停用词名单的影响

words_standard_only <- words %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word")


word_counts_standard_only <- words_standard_only %>%
  count(doc_title, word, sort = TRUE)


top15_standard_only <- word_counts_standard_only %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = doc_title,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(max_n = pmax(`Text A`, `Text B`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)


print(top15_standard_only, n = 15, width = Inf)


View(top15_standard_only)

```
